firstPartyCooldown.prompt: Using a base-ten sketch, show how 132 is shared among six equal groups. Explain each exchange.
firstPartyCooldown.teacherAnswer: 22 each: 1 hundred→10 tens; combine 3 tens to get 13; share 12 tens, leaving 1 ten; exchange to 10 ones, add 2 ones, distribute 12 ones; 2 tens + 2 ones in each of 6 groups.
